title: ED renal colic documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports clinician-reviewed CT or ultrasound imaging with age and pregnancy qualifiers.
user_facing_items.population: Adults, children, and young people with suspected or confirmed renal or ureteric stones, with age and pregnancy qualifiers.
user_facing_items.setting: Assessment, imaging, procedural management, metabolic testing, prevention, and follow-up of renal and ureteric stones.
restrictions: Exact only for selected stone identity, imaging, stone-analysis, metabolic-workup, hydration-context, and clinician-discussed prevention documentation. Acute symptom assessment, treatment, procedures, fixed follow-up, and UAE pathways remain clinician responsibilities.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact NICE stone-imaging section supports documenting existing test or imaging status only when performed or reviewed; it does not infer a stone or recommend imaging.
